question: What capacity is revealed even in a single instant for those skilled in grasping details?
premises: Even in the fall of a single instant, a certain attainment can be present.
That attainment is the state of having gained all-knowingness and all-doingness.
This is especially evident for those skilled in unwavering attention to particular details.
inference: For experts with steady attention to particulars, a single instant can manifest the powers of omniscience and omnipotence.
uncertainties: The scope of sarvajña-sarvakartṛtva here may be analogical rather than absolute.
plain_english: Even in a single instant, those who are skilled in unwaveringly grasping particular details attain, from that very moment, a state of all-knowing and all-doing.
